name: inbox-labeler
description: Label Gmail with categories you define, using the Inbox Labeler app for your label definitions.

interface.shortDescription: Label your mail with categories you define
interface.longDescription: Describe in plain language what matters to you in an email. Inbox Labeler detects it in new unread mail and applies it as a Gmail label, stars or marks read what each label asks for, and shows already processed mail grouped for scanning. Label definitions live in the Inbox Labeler app.
